req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update a post when the correct endpoint is called by the author with valid data. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful updates, a negative test to handle unauthorized updates, and a boundary test to check behavior with minimal valid input.

tests.name: test_update_post_success
preconditions: Post with id 2 exists and is authored by Rahul
actions: Call POST /2/update with valid title and body
expected: Post is updated with new title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Login as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Update post
r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_unauthorized
preconditions: Post with id 2 exists and is authored by Rahul
actions: Call POST /2/update with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Login as Anjali
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})

# Attempt to update Rahul's post
r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Unauthorized Update', 'body': 'Should fail'})
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_update_post_minimal_title
preconditions: Post with id 2 exists and is authored by Rahul
actions: Call POST /2/update with minimal valid title and body
expected: Post is updated with new minimal title and body
